cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Warmly Withholding
cards.instruction: Remain open, caring, and reassuring while revealing less with every new question.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm pointing where you pointed on the map. Our depot, yes. Your wedding dress arrived this morning. Please sit; I'll look after you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's where I'm getting married. Which depot? I'll collect it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One of ours. Let me save you a wasted journey.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can you at least give me their number?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You have me, and I'm staying right here with you.

reason: Name the map in the spoken opening so the location error does not depend on the planning outline.
